description: Published Knesset26 polling-building points, Hebrew addresses and Census2022 area assignments. Coordinates describe the building, not voter residence. Search by locality code, translated locality name, station label or published address.

election_id.description: latest, a Knesset ID such as k26, or full YYYY-MM-DD date. A bare 2019 is ambiguous.

limit.description: Maximum matching records per page, 1–50; default 10.

locality_code.description: Filter by official CBS locality code, for example 4000 for Haifa. Omit to search across localities.

offset.description: Number of matching polling-station records to skip, 0–100000; default 0.

query.description: Optional search text, up to 100 characters; empty means no text filter.

name: search_polling_stations
